description: This file is a PHP script for handling the migration process in the vtiger CRM system. It includes license information, session management, security checks, file copying utilities, and generates HTML/JavaScript for the migration UI. It also handles starting and completing the migration process.

methods.name: Migration_Utils::copyRequiredFiles
methods.description: Copies necessary files during migration from source to destination directory.

methods.name: Migration_Utils::migrate
methods.description: Performs the migration process based on session information.

methods.name: LoggerManager::getLogger
methods.description: Retrieves a logger instance for logging migration activities.
